"anim" : "fadedrop", "dur" : 300 }, "items" : "voidanim" } } } Strong Vibe at Great Wines of the Andes USA 2018 Monday, October 15, 2018 This year’s Great Wines of the Andes USA finished with a bang in Miami with close to 800 people tasting hundreds of wines and meeting dozens of wine producers at the East Hotel on October 5. “Miami loves great wines and it loves great values like the wines of the Andes,’ said James Suckling, editor and CEO of JamesSucking.com, organizers of the event. Suckling emphasized at the event that the outstanding quality wines of Chile, Argentina and Uruguay were exceptional values in the wine world today whereby the consumer and trade would need to pay two or three times the price for wines from other countries to receive the same quality in the bottle The message was the same in the other two cities, New York and San Francisco, during the three-city tour beginning on September 30. Suckling and a group of close to 150 wineries attended the four-hour tasting events. Suckling’s close friend Surahn Sidhu , the award-winning Australian recording artist, provided a sleek mix of Cuban funk and regional music together for the events. A guitarist, bass, and vocal for Empire of the Sun in the past, Sidhu is often on tours across the globe and just started his own new band in Australia. With such a strong vibe and great wines, Great Wines of the Andes USA 2018 was the biggest event ever for the five-year-old walk-around tasting. Check out the video of the event and photos below. Great Wines of the Andes San Francisco: 700 people attended the Andes event last Sunday, Sept 30 on the second edition of Andes in San Francisco Andres Blanchard & Javier Catena, partners in Cuarto Dominio poured the wines across all cities this year Argentine wines keep attracting more and more crowds in San Francisco Aurelio Montes Jr. explains the beauty of Montes wines to the San Francisco attendees Claudia Benegas pours the wines, Don Tiburcio was one of the discoveries for locals who attended the event Eduardo Chadwick and Rodrigo Soto, two legends in Chile present at San Francisco event James chats and poses with San Francisco enthusiastic crowd another full event last Sunday in SF Laura Catena pours her wines to San Francisco wine lovers Los Vascos & Caro, the Lafite projects in Andes were only present in San Francisco, treating the locals to this amazing wines Matias Ciciani poured Escorihuela Gascon in all three cities .JPG San Francisco loves Andes wines, 700 wine lovers and trade people packed the Golden Gate Club on Sunday Sept 30 Mele Sosa poured Garzon wines once again in San Francisco, the crowd loves this Uruguay wine Piero Incisa poured his amazing Chacra Pinot Noirs JamesSuckling.com supports Sea Shepherd, always present at our events Uruguay was present with Garzon wines Great Wines of the Andes New York: Alfredo Frigeiro pours Los Toneles for the first time at our event to the NY crowd Diego Surazsky pouring Norton wines to the NY crowd.JPG Emmanuelle BonnCuvelier de los Andes.JPG Full house at IAC with Great Wines of the Andes 2018 edition. 800 attendees packed IAC Building on Oct 2 Gaston Williams with Vik explains the beauty of the Cachapoal wines German de Cesare joined us only in New York and poured Trivento wines Gustavo Hormann, Kaiken winemaker joined us on the whole tour and met Mai lovers along the way James among the 800 people that packed IAC building in NY Javier Catena poured Cuarto Domino wines in NY Jorge Dehese pours Nina wines from the only winery at the event from La Rioja, Argentina. Matetic joined NY GWA for the first time this year, attracting curious palates to their wines New Yorkers love Andes wines, big supporters from our first edition four years ago Ramiro Barrios with Michel Rolland's wines Clos de los Siete was one the newcomers to our NY edition Ricardo Arrambide was present in NY edition with Flecha de los Andes wines The diversity of wines that Andes produce kept all palates busy and happy throughout the event Veronique Bonnie Laplane pours Diamandes, one of the best values from Argentina's Valle de Uco The official Andes guidebook .JPG Great Wines of the Andes Miami: The Crush was packed with people tasting the Chilean wines all night, playing along with Surahn's music The 100 point acclaimed Clos Apalta was the only 100 point wine featured at the event this year in all three cities Surahn Sidhu's music gave special ambience to the event Nicolas Montovano & Carolina Graziano pouring Rutini wines in Miami Miami crowd is always enthusiastic about our event and study our guidebook from head to toes Miami crowd is always happy to have Andes back in town Miami crowd filled East throughout the entire tasting Miami crowd always a big fan of Andes is looking forward to our next Italy event in March Leandro Lowi pours for Zuccardi in Miami, the only city where Zuccardi was present James greets the Miami enthusiastic crowd James and the enthusiastic crowd in Miami Italo Jofre and Isabel Giulisasti pouring the famous Don Melchor in Miami Gabriel Baigorria from Mi Terruno attends Miami event Dennis Koelewijn pours Pyros and Salentein wines, exclusively in Miami Danielle Thompson showing Almaviva, one of the most popular wines at the Tasting Hector Durigutti pours his Malbec at East Miami Chris O'Donnell, Michel Couttlolenc and Berenice Maulhardt toasting to another great edition of GWA Miami Agustina Briuzela pours Mascota wines to enthusiastic Miami attendeees Charles de Bournet and Albert Somoza busy pouring Lapostolle and Clos Apalta all evening Andrea Ferreira from La Celia wines was present in Miami
